entries.reviewLaneReason: Cliopatria identifies a polity absent from the OHM identity crosswalk.
entries.notes: The Hellenic State under Governor Kapodistrias. On 1830-01-01 the Porte had accepted the London Treaty of 1827 at Adrianople (1829-09-14), which still envisaged an autonomous tributary state; full independence was recognized by the London Protocol of 1830-02-03. Ottoman authority was absent, no tribute was ever paid, and the state is treated as de facto sovereign, matching the GC tag. Judgment call. The Cliopatria label is a later name, and its Crete component and a stray Rhineland fragment are removed by a reviewed component filter.
